title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Payloads and Exploits, and Scanners, Oh my!
summary: This release has something for everyone: scanner modules, payloads, and exploits. This release’s scanners cover Drupal, PanOS, WordPress, and SCADA; this release’s exploits cover Tenable, Flowise, CheckPoint, Langflow, Ruby, and SPIP.
body_markdown:
This release has something for everyone: scanner modules, payloads, and exploits. This release’s scanners cover Drupal, PanOS, WordPress, and SCADA; this release’s exploits cover Tenable, Flowise, CheckPoint, Langflow, Ruby, and SPIP.


## New module content (16)


### Forgejo Arbitrary File Read via Org-mode Include


Authors: NightRang3r and xbow-security


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21778](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21778) contributed by[jvoisin](https://github.com/jvoisin)


Path:` gather/forgejo_orgmode_fileread_cve_2026_59774`


Description: Adds module targeting CVE-2026-59774, an arbitrary file read in Forgejo 7.0 through 15.0.5 and 16.0.0–16.0.1.


### Wordpress Planyo Online Reservation System Arbitrary File Read (CVE-2026-3576)


Authors: Balachandar Gowrisankar and sinn3r[\[email protected\]](https://www.rapid7.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ccbfa5a2a2ffbe8ca1a9b8adbfbca0a3a5b8e2afa3a1)


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21769](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21769) contributed by[anirbala98](https://github.com/anirbala98)


Path:` gather/wp_planyo_lfi_cve_2026_3576`


Description: This adds a module for, CVE-2026-3576, a local file inclusion vulnerability via server side request forgery in WordPress's Planyo Online Reservation System plugin (versions < 3.1). The plugin's AJAX proxy ulap.php does not validate the scheme of URLs supplied to it. This allows unauthenticated attackers to supply file:// URLs to ulap.php and retrieve any arbitrary local file contents from the target.


### Concrete CMS Unauthenticated File Usage Disclosure


Author: dividesbyzer0


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21695](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21695) contributed by[zoomdbz](https://github.com/zoomdbz)


Path:` scanner/http/concrete_cms_file_usage_disclosure`


Description: Adds an auxiliary scanner module for CVE-2026-6826: Concrete CMS 9.x before 9.5.1 exposes the file usage dialog controller at /ccm/system/dialogs/file/usage/<fID> without a view permission check.


### Drupal Core PostgreSQL EntityQuery SQL Injection


Author: Lukas Johannes Moeller


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21765](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21765) contributed by[JohannesLks](https://github.com/JohannesLks)


Path:` scanner/http/drupal_pgsql_entityquery_sqli`


Description: This adds a new module: drupal_pgsql_entityquery_sqli for CVE-2026-9082, an unauthenticated SQL injection in Drupal core's PostgreSQL EntityQuery condition handler. The module confirms the injection using the framework's PostgreSQL time-based blind SQLi implementation.


### PAN-OS GlobalProtect CAS CVE-2026-0265 Vulnerability Checker


Authors: Bishop Fox Team X and Rapid7 Research / Deral Heiland adaptation


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21610](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21610) contributed by[percx](https://github.com/percx)


Path:` scanner/http/panos_cve_2026_0265`


Description: Adds a new Metasploit auxiliary scanner module for safely detecting CVE-2026-0265 affecting PAN-OS GlobalProtect portals when Clientless Application Services (CAS) authentication is enabled.


### WordPress Core wp2shell Unauthenticated SQL Injection via REST Batch Route Confusion


Authors: Searchlight Cyber and dividesbyzer0


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21694](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21694) contributed by[zoomdbz](https://github.com/zoomdbz)


Path:` scanner/http/wordpress_wp2shell_sqli`


Description: Adds an auxiliary scanner module for the "wp2shell" WordPress core unauthenticated SQL injection: REST batch route confusion (CVE-2026-63030) chained with the WP_Query author__not_in string interpolation (CVE-2026-60137). Affects WordPress core 6.9.0-6.9.4 and 7.0.0-7.0.1 (fixed in 6.9.5 / 7.0.2, 2026-07-17).

### OPC-UA Server Detection

### Langflow AI auto_login RCE


Author: Richard Howe <rhowe425>

### Ruby on Rails Active Storage Vips Arbitrary File Read and Remote Code Execution


Authors: 0xacb, Crypto-Cat, RyotaK, castilho, and s3np41k1r1t0


Type: Exploit


Pull request:[#21733](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21733) contributed by[jburgess-r7](https://github.com/jburgess-r7)


Path:` multi/http/rails_activestorage_vips_rce`


Description: This adds an exploit module for CVE-2026-66066, a remote code execution vulnerability in Ruby on Rails Active Storage. The module chains a` libvips` arbitrary file read (via crafted HDF5/MATLAB images) with` secret_key_base` recovery to achieve RCE through the ImageProcessing gem, supporting Unix command, Linux fetch, and native Ruby payload targets.


### SPIP X-Spip-Filtre Unauthenticated RCE


Author: Julien Voisin


Type: Exploit


Pull request:[#21790](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21790) contributed by[jvoisin](https://github.com/jvoisin)


Path:` multi/http/spip_x_spip_filtre_rce`


Description: This module exploits a PHP function-call injection in SPIP's template engine before versions 4.4.21 to achieve unauthenticated RCE. The` analyse_resultat_skel()` function extracts` <?php header("X-Spip-Filtre: ..."); ?>` patterns from the rendered page body and calls the listed functions as template filters.


### Linux Execute Command exec() payload


Author: Diego Ledda


Type: Payload (Single)


Pull request:[#21445](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21445) contributed by[dledda-r7](https://github.com/dledda-r7)


Path:` linux/mips64/exec`


Description: Adds MIPS64 exec payload, MIPSEL and MIPSBE exec payload update, and prepends for all three.


## Enhanced Modules (1)


Modules which have either been enhanced, or renamed:


- [#21795](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21795) from[vognik](https://github.com/vognik) - Updates the Ghost CMS authenticated RCE module to construct an Origin header that matches Ghost’s canonical site URL by omitting standard ports (80/443) while keeping non-standard ports, preventing Ghost’s strict RFC 6454 origin validation from rejecting requests.


## Enhancements and features (8)


- [#21378](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21378) from[g0tmi1k](https://github.com/g0tmi1k) - Cleans up the ftp_version module, offloading some methods to a mixin, increases comments, and removes unused options.
- [#21402](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21402) from[karanabe](https://github.com/karanabe) - Adds a SessionType option to` auxiliary/scanner/winrm/winrm_login` so successful WinRM logins can create either the existing cmd-backed shell, a PSRP-backed PowerShell session, or automatically fall back to PowerShell when cmd shell creation is denied.
- [#21496](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21496) from[h00die](https://github.com/h00die) - Not written - add release notes directly to the pull request, then regenerate. Do not edit manually without ensuring the pull request has the release note present.
- [#21573](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21573) from[jheysel-r7](https://github.com/jheysel-r7) - Adds support to the Post Mixin for Windows sessions to run the .writable? method.
- [#21644](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21644) from[dwelch-r7](https://github.com/dwelch-r7) - Improves start up performance of msfconsole.
- [#21717](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21717) from[eve0805](https://github.com/eve0805) - Not written - add release notes directly to the pull request, then regenerate. Do not edit manually without ensuring the pull request has the release note present.
- [#21779](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21779) from[bwatters-r7](https://github.com/bwatters-r7) - This extends` windows/smb/psexec` to work with aarch64 targets.
- [#21789](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21789) from[h00die](https://github.com/h00die) - Adds a new command line flag to print the count of modules.


## Bugs fixed (11)


- [#21184](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21184) from[Hemang360](https://github.com/Hemang360) - Fix inconsistencies between report_service and create_credential.
- [#21569](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21569) from[dwelch-r7](https://github.com/dwelch-r7) - Not written - add release notes directly to the pull request, then regenerate. Do not edit manually without ensuring the pull request has the release note present.
- [#21742](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21742) from[dwelch-r7](https://github.com/dwelch-r7) - Replace` ::Timeout.timeout` +` Queue#deq(false)` with` Queue#deq(timeout:)` in` TcpServerChannel#accept` to increase reliability in Ruby 3.x.
- [#21783](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21783) from[eipoverflow](https://github.com/eipoverflow) - Bumps rex-bin_tools to bring in the changes from[https://github.com/rapid7/rex-bin_tools/pull/16](https://github.com/rapid7/rex-bin_tools/pull/16) , which fixes a bug in the calculation of section sizes.
- [#21784](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21784) from[Pushpenderrathore](https://github.com/Pushpenderrathore) - This pull request fixes two uncaught exceptions in the default DNS forward/cache path that would silently kill the listener thread when finalizing an empty response. The crashes were caused by incorrect method calls to the Dnsruby library, which have been updated to use the proper rcode= setter and #encode serializer. As a result, the DNS server now correctly handles and forwards out-of-scope queries without terminating.
- [#21793](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21793) from[h00die](https://github.com/h00die) - fixes a bug in our rsync banner grab that was broken because rsync changed their banner in protocol 32.
- [#21797](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21797) from[d1mov](https://github.com/d1mov) - Corrects incorrect` check` method that failed to include Windows Server 2019, even though it is vulnerable.
- [#21799](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21799) from[dledda-r7](https://github.com/dledda-r7) - Adds automatic payload selection when changing targets.
- [#21804](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21804) from[dledda-r7](https://github.com/dledda-r7) - Fixes a bug where shellcode prepends were added to the beginning of fetch command payloads rather than the beginning of the binary payloads delivered by fetch command payloads.
- [#21816](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21816) from[h00die](https://github.com/h00die) - Fixes SSH Version scanner to work on ancient versions of SSH.
- [#21832](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21832) from[jheysel-r7](https://github.com/jheysel-r7) - This fixes an issue with the ldap_esc_vulnerable_cert_finder module where it wasn't properly rescuing an HTTPTimeout exception when the Domain Controller's WinRM service wouldn't respond to the module's version check. Now the module catches the exception and handles it properly allowing the module to continue preventing a crash.

## Get it


As always, you can update to the latest Metasploit Framework with` msfupdate` and you can get more details on the changes since the last blog post from GitHub:


- [Pull Requests 6.5.2...6.5.3](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pulls?q=is:pr+merged:%222026-08-13T15%3A07%3A46%2B01%3A00..2026-08-27T12%3A02%3A38%2B01%3A00%22)
- [Full diff 6.5.2...6.5.3](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/compare/6.5.2...6.5.3)


If you are a` git` user, you can clone the[Metasploit Framework repo](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework) (master branch) for the latest. To install fresh without using git, you can use the open-source-only[Nightly Installers](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/wiki/Nightly-Installers) or the commercial edition[Metasploit Pro](https://www.rapid7.com/products/metasploit/download/)
